ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: speaker
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Chairs the council's meetings and speaks for the colony. A good speaker slowly builds the colony's trust in the council.

duties.li: Everyone's trust in the council rises a little each day.
The speaker is more persuasive (social impact and negotiation).

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} cleared {PAWN_possessive} throat at supper and the room went quiet, which surprised everyone, {PAWN_nameDef} most of all.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises short meetings. Nobody believes it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has already been asked to settle three arguments, and settled two of them.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: marshal
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Leads the colony's defense: runs the drills, sets the watches and is first to the wall when raiders come.

duties.li: Drills train everyone half again as fast.
Colonists aim and strike a little better.
The marshal fights better and holds steady under fire.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} walked the wall before dark and moved two of the sandbags a hand's width to the left.
{PAWN_nameDef} has announced a drill for tomorrow at dawn, to general groaning.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to know where everyone sleeps, in case.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: quartermaster
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the stores, counts the silver and haggles with traders.

duties.li: Answers to dilemmas that cost food, wood or silver cost a quarter less.
The quartermaster gets better prices from traders.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} counted the stores that same evening, twice, and frowned both times.
{PAWN_nameDef} has started a ledger, and the cook is already in it.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the next trader is going to regret coming.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: physician
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: The colony's chief doctor: runs the hospital, sets bones and decides who's fit to work.

duties.li: Everyone heals and fights off illness a little faster.
The physician tends wounds and operates more skillfully.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} washed {PAWN_possessive} hands, looked around the infirmary, and started making a list.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked everyone how they were sleeping, and wrote the answers down.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the first rule is clean hands, and the second rule is also clean hands.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: steward
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's spirits: feasts, festivals, and keeping expectations down to earth.

duties.li: Everyone's standards rise a quarter more slowly.
The steward gets more out of recreation.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has already asked what everyone would like for the next feast.
{PAWN_nameDef} says a colony that never celebrates forgets why it bothers, and means to fix that.
{PAWN_nameDef} lit a lamp in the common room and left it burning, as a start.
